ENV_ROWS_WITNESS.source_env_axis: explicit integer axis with source extent80
ENV_ROWS_WITNESS.mapping: explicit caller Python IDs; index contents not read back

ENV_IDS_FULL.dtype: actual original integer dtype, including int32

QUEUE_GROUP_FULL.source_env_axis: explicit integer axis with source extent80
QUEUE_GROUP_FULL.selection: detach().clone(); every queue group row retained
QUEUE_GROUP_FULL.difference_from_frozen_design: NEW explicit role; queue groups keep full80 rather than generic witness8

source_ref_alias: source_pin_ref == source_ref; source_ref is the API parameter
source_authority: caller-supplied source reference; codec does not authenticate live SDK provenance

data.capture: owned same-device tensor, no CPU copy/cast
data.materialize: explicit outside-loop detach().cpu().tolist() only; metadata preserved; no float()/dtype cast
data.roundtrip: JSON-native integers/bools/floats retain original dtype metadata; not a bitwise tensor wire-format or implicit float32 reconstruction
data.bare_tensor: CaptureError: every tensor requires an explicit role
data.caller_ownership: handoff buffers and metadata are read-only; ledger stores references without a second clone

original_clock.normal_slot: phase scene_update, reset_depth0, original100Hz flag true; mid tick%8==4, end tick>0 and tick%8==0

ledger.reset: reset(ids, *, clock, event_id, before=None, after=None, outcome='RETURNED')
ledger.reset_site: original reset hook finally/completion, using its already-owned before/after/IDs; no new reset
ledger.finish: finish() returns already-owned tree; caller separately materializes outside loop
ledger.observed_reset: original complete ID envelope even if K0, K80 or outcome RAISED
ledger.link: run/control + prior termination event captured before reset + original clocks; late pre cannot retroactively repair a link
ledger.incomplete: missing normal/pre/actor or unjoined edge retained as INCOMPLETE, never synthesized
ledger.all_controls_observed: count only, not complete retention, native validation or Gate1
ledger.metadata_failure: CaptureError; caller must preserve original callback count/identity/exception, never replay or SDK fallback
